episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Knocked out by fierce winds while paragliding through the air, Yoon Se Ri wakes up on the north side of the Korean DMZ, where Ri Jung Hyuk finds her.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After talking Jung Hyuk and his comrades into hiding her in his home, Se Ri gets a taste of his way of life. Goo Seung Joon buys refuge in Pyongyang.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Jung Hyuk invents a bold background story for Se Ri, but Cho Chul Gang isn't so easy to fool. Seo Dan returns to North Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When her escape plan falls through, Se Ri turns to another idea for a way out. Dan heads to the village to see Jung Hyuk.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jung Hyuk agrees to marry Dan sooner, as his parents wish, but they must do him a favour first. Seung Joon catches a glimpse of Se Ri.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Dan is less than happy when she hears Jung Hyuk and Se Ri are at a hotel together. Meanwhile, Seung Joon plays what cards he has to save himself.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A flight out of North Korea awaits Se Ri at the airport. But unwilling to leave Jung Hyuk while he's injured, she brings him to the hospital instead.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Keeping Jung Hyuk away from Se Ri turns out to be much more difficult than Seung Joon anticipated. Chul Gang stays on their tail.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Se Ri faces her kidnapper. Elsewhere, Jung Hyuk is forced to spread a formidable rumour about himself in order to escape Chul Gang's clutches.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Back to her cushy life in the spotlight, Se Ri takes care of business -- though nothing feels quite the same. Jung Hyuk goes after Chul Gang.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: It's Jung Hyuk's turn to adjust to a new world. Back in North Korea, Dan gives Seung Joon a place to stay after he loses his protection.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Hoping to meet Jung Hyuk, his comrades attend an event hosted by Se Ri's company. Seung Joon opens up to Dan over a bowl of rice porridge.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Se Ri sends the comrades on a shopping spree, and plays hooky from work with Jung Hyuk. Jung Man Bok encounters a dilemma.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: While Jung Hyuk keeps watch over Se Ri, his comrades make themselves useful. Seung Joon can't stop worrying about Dan.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: South Korean officials try to figure out what's going on, but they're given conflicting stories. Seung Joon flees from his captors.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Before departing, Jung Hyuk leaves behind a surprise that keeps on giving. Dan delivers bittersweet justice.
